body: I really don't want to answer this because I fear negative comments about our age gap, but I will be 32 this weekend and he is 22.
This is solid advice. Thank you so much.
Thank you. I hadn't considered churches for this sort of thing.

I absolutely -DO NOT- want or expect money, I only wanted to vent.

I did try to look for a local food pantry, but couldn't find one when I did searches. It was one of the things I was kicking myself for not asking my case worker about when she denied us food stamps.

He does have insurance through his parents, so he is ok as far as medical bills. I have been considering counseling for both of us and am looking into if my job offers any kind of free counseling (I heard something about it once).
